tools.name: proof_spec
tools.description: The machine verification spec for the ChainHelix attestation stream

tools.name: list_reveals
tools.description: Matured signal reveals with Merkle paths. Optional month YYYY-MM and limit

tools.name: verify_reveal
tools.description: Recompute the hash and Merkle fold for one reveal by sequence number. Returns each check result plus the data to re-verify independently on chain

tools.name: attestation_stats
tools.description: Live counts of the attestation stream: committed, anchored, revealed, gaps

tools.name: attest_spec
tools.description: The machine verification spec for the attestation service — how sealed claims are hashed, put on chain and verified independently

tools.name: attest
tools.description: Requires a ChainHelix API key as bearer token, or 5 cents in USDC per call paid over x402 on the Base network. tools.name: attest_status
tools.description: Check one sealed claim by tenant plus seq or hash. Before reveal time only the receipt shows; after it the claim text and salt are included

tools.name: list_attestations
tools.description: A tenant’s full sealed-claim stream, newest first. Matured claims include their text and salt. Optional limit up to 200

tools.name: webhook_register
tools.description: Requires a ChainHelix API key as bearer token, or 70 cents in USDC per call paid over x402 on the Base network. tools.name: webhook_status
tools.description: Your registered webhooks for your tenant identity (your paying wallet, or your key id), optionally narrowed to one id. Requires your tenant so it can only show your own webhooks; never returns the signing secret

tools.name: webhook_unregister
tools.description: Remove a webhook. Takes the id and the signing secret from registration — only the holder of the secret can remove it

tools.name: prices
tools.description: Requires a ChainHelix API key as bearer token, or 1 cent in USDC per call paid over x402 on the Base network. Live price for every chain in one call — the one cent market check. Omit chain for all nine

tools.name: latest_signals
tools.description: Requires a ChainHelix API key as bearer token, or 6 cents in USDC per call paid over x402 on the Base network. The live ChainHelix signal stream, newest first. Each signal names chain, direction, entry price, win probability and a conviction score with its ranking tier, and every one is sealed on ch

tools.name: situation_report
tools.description: Requires a ChainHelix API key as bearer token, or 5 cents in USDC per call paid over x402 on the Base network. The full market picture in one call: market state, price walls, large transfers, bot activity and the Bitcoin queue for every chain in a single report. Omit chain for all nine

tools.name: deep_report
tools.description: Requires a ChainHelix API key as bearer token, or 25 cents in USDC per call paid over x402 on the Base network. The complete nine chain research brief in one call: the full market report with price walls, large transfers and bot activity, the live signal stream with conviction scores and ranking tie

tools.name: market_state
tools.description: Requires a ChainHelix API key as bearer token, or 2 cents in USDC per call paid over x402 on the Base network. Regime, range age and volatility state per chain. Omit chain for all nine

tools.name: mev_intel
tools.description: Requires a ChainHelix API key as bearer token, or 2 cents in USDC per call paid over x402 on the Base network. MEV event rates per chain and type vs the trailing weekly pace. window in hours, default 24, max 168

tools.name: wall_map
tools.description: Requires a ChainHelix API key as bearer token, or 2 cents in USDC per call paid over x402 on the Base network. Support and resistance price walls per chain with touch counts, from hourly to weekly market structure — the same wall map the ChainHelix engine trades with. Omit chain for all nine

tools.name: whale_flows
tools.description: Requires a ChainHelix API key as bearer token, or 2 cents in USDC per call paid over x402 on the Base network. Large transfer counts and USD totals per chain. window in hours default 24 max 168, threshold 500000 USD

tools.name: congestion
tools.description: Requires a ChainHelix API key as bearer token, or 2 cents in USDC per call paid over x402 on the Base network. Bitcoin queue depth and fee level now vs the past 30 days

tools.name: correlation_matrix
tools.description: Requires a ChainHelix API key as bearer token, or 2 cents in USDC per call paid over x402 on the Base network. Pairwise correlation of hourly returns across the nine chains. window in days default 7 max 30

tools.name: iv_summary
tools.description: Requires a ChainHelix API key as bearer token, or 2 cents in USDC per call paid over x402 on the Base network. Near term option implied volatility for Bitcoin and Ethereum, now vs one week ago

tools.name: session_stats
tools.description: Requires a ChainHelix API key as bearer token, or 2 cents in USDC per call paid over x402 on the Base network. Share of price movement per trading session over 7 days. Sessions are Asia London New York in UTC thirds

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.chainhelix.io" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: webhook_register · Private data: attest, webhook_register, webhook_status, webhook_unregister, prices, latest_signals, situation_report, deep_report, market_state, mev_intel, wall_map, whale_flows, congestion, correlation_matrix, iv_summary, session_stats · Public sink: attest, webhook_register, webhook_status, webhook_unregister, session_stats · Destructive: webhook_unregister.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: webhook_register · Private data: attest, webhook_register, webhook_status, webhook_unregister, prices, latest_signals, situation_report, deep_report, market_state, mev_intel, wall_map, whale_flows, congestion, correlation_matrix, iv_summary, session_stats · Public sink: attest, webhook_register, webhook_status, webhook_unregister, session_stats · Destructive: webhook_unregister

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
